# Blocked components and artifacts

- Any checkpoint, dataset, noise archive, or RIR without an explicit artifact license: `BLOCKED_UNKNOWN`.
- YAMNet weights/model exports: repository source license does not establish weight license.
- RNNoise external model artifacts: no verified license in intake.
- Any GPL, AGPL, SSPL, BUSL, non-commercial, research-only, no-derivatives, custom restrictive, unknown, or unlicensed implementation: do not copy.

These items may be described, never silently treated as usable.
